idea-plugin.name: idelink
idea-plugin.description: A narrow, peer-gated bridge that lets Claude Code on the host present files and read IDE state. The frontend module (thin client) reports editor state (paths, caret, selection bounds; no contents) and displays what the backend sends: open-at-line, a show-only diff, a review tour. Terminal tabs the user shares (per tab, off by default) can be read on request; nothing ever types into a terminal.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.2

  • First public release, for the 2026.2.4 releases of PyCharm, GoLand, IntelliJ IDEA and Rider (through 2026.3).
  • Claude can open files, show proposed changes as show-only diffs, give review tours, read the editor state and the IDE's own analysis, and read terminal tabs you share. Every Claude session needs your approval first.
